answer: Re-attestations are stored in trellis and horizon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the wander graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1317 impostors cost 1978 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
